text: The harness demonstrates severe accuracy degradation across datasets: ds_alpha at 0%, ds_beta at 38% train/48% eval, and ds_gamma showing continued poor performance, indicating the learning approach is fundamentally broken. The memory state remains empty ("{}", 2 chars) throughout all training phases, revealing that the online learning mechanism fails to capture or apply learned patterns during evaluation. Reasoning traces are uniformly generic ("Closest demonstrations suggest [answer]"), indicating the demonstration retrieval system is malfunctioning rather than meaningfully selecting in-context examples. Performance metrics show mode collapse rather than adaptation: ds_beta exhibits strong bias toward high-frequency answers that succeed only ~50% of the time, while scaling training data from 80 to 180 examples actually worsens generalization. Key improvements needed: fix memory state tracking to actually persist learning, redesign demonstration selection to enable effective in-context learning, and investigate why expanded training sets fail to improve performance.
